أَبِىٌّ and أَبِيَةٌ: see آبٍ, in three places. ―
-b2- Also, the former (أَبِىٌّ), She [app. a camel, or any beast,] that refuses, or refrains from, fodder, by reason of her suffering from indigestion: and she that refuses, or refrains from, the stallion, by reason of her having little appetency. (AA.) [See also أَوَابٍ, voce آبٍ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
